notes.title: Official release of Potty Knight Saga!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797128/da2d4827c1b68490cd35e1865efafdd5c9d08f54.png[/img]

We’ve received a lot of feedback during the open testing phase. 
We’ve improved the graphics and controls, and meticulously designed the levels! Most importantly, 
you can no longer predict when our cute characters will fart! 
Why? Because it makes the game much more fun and allows for diverse gameplay!

Enjoy!

notes.title: will be officially released next week!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Finally, <Potty Knight Saga> will be officially released next week!

We are currently working hard to squash any remaining bugs and continue testing the finalized balance. We understand that many of you are curious about the exact release date, so here it is:


[b]The official release dates for <Potty Knight Saga> by country are as follows:[/b]

[b]KST (Korea): March 8th, 9:00 AM
CST: March 8th, 8:00 AM
PST: March 7th, 4:00 PM
CET: March 7th, 1:00 AM[/b]

I will continue to work tirelessly with you to create more fun and amazing games even after the official release. Thank you.
